name: life
seeds: My name is Grace Njeri Kamau. I live in Nyali, Mombasa, with my husband Samuel Ochieng and our two children, Wanjiku and Baraka. Samuel and I married on 12 December 2009.
Wanjiku was born on 20 May 2011 and Baraka on 2 February 2014.
My late father, Joseph Kamau Mwangi, died on 3 March 2011. My mother Esther Wanjiru Kamau, born 1 September 1951, still lives on the family farm in Nyeri.
My brother Peter Mwangi Kamau was born on 14 August 1979. His wife Mercy Wambui teaches in Nakuru. I also have a half-brother, Daniel Otieno, my dad's son with Rose Akinyi.
Samuel's sister, Atieno Ochieng, is Wanjiku's godmother. My cousin Njoroge Kamau runs a matatu business in Thika.
My best friend Halima Abdalla and I founded Njeri Bakes in March 2019. I own 60% and Halima 40%, and I'm the managing director.
Njeri Bakes supplies Nyali Beach Hotel, our biggest client. Halima handles the kitchen while I handle the money. She's a great business partner.
When Dad died, Peter and I inherited the farm in Nyeri; we own it together. It's about 5 acres.
I work at Pwani Logistics Ltd as finance manager. I joined in March 2016, after eight years as an accountant at Coast Commercial Bank. My salary is KES 280,000 a month.
My boss at Pwani is Faith Achieng, the CFO. Brian Kiptoo, who sits next to me, is a colleague in the finance team.
Before Mombasa we lived in Nairobi; we moved down in April 2016. We kept our flat in Kilimani until I sold it to Kevin Mutua in September 2023 for KES 6,500,000.
We rent our house in Nyali from Wycliffe Barasa, who is also our neighbour across the road. We've rented it since May 2016.

seeds.text:
SALE AGREEMENT
Seller: Kahindi Charo
Buyer: Grace Njeri Kamau
Property: Plot No. KILIFI/MTONDIA/1187, Kilifi County (the Kilifi plot)
Price: KES 1,800,000
Date: 15 January 2020

seeds: Correction on the Kilifi plot: the price in the agreement was a typo. I actually paid KES 1,750,000.
We're building our house on the Kilifi plot. The total budget is KES 4,500,000 and we hope to finish by December 2026.
Juma Hamisi is the fundi doing the masonry on the Kilifi house. I paid him KES 450,000 on 10 March 2024 for the foundation, which was finished in May 2024.
Nimemlipa Bakari Electricals shilingi 120,000 tarehe 18 Novemba 2025 kwa kazi ya nyaya za umeme kwenye nyumba ya Kilifi. Kuta zote zilikamilika Agosti 2025.

seeds.text:
From: Omari Salim
Subject: Roofing quote

Dear Grace,
My quote for the Kilifi house roof is KES 380,000, materials included. I can start in February.
Regards,
Omari

seeds: Omari quit after two weeks, so we hired Kazungu Roofing instead. I paid Kazungu Roofing KES 400,000 on 12 April 2026 and the roof was done in May 2026.
Peter sent KES 200,000 towards the Kilifi house in June 2025, and Samuel has put in KES 1,000,000 so far.
In January 2026 Peter and I each paid KES 75,000 of Mum's hospital bill at Aga Khan Hospital Mombasa.
I lent Brian KES 30,000 in February 2026 for his wedding. He paid me back on 2 May 2026.
I have a KES 500,000 development loan from Stima Sacco, and Wycliffe Barasa is my guarantor on it.
Every month I contribute KES 5,000 to the Umoja Women's Chama; I've been a member since 2018.
Nyali Beach Hotel paid Njeri Bakes KES 150,000 for the March orders on 5 April 2026.
Halima and I decided last week to open a second Njeri Bakes outlet in Mtwapa, with a budget of KES 800,000. By the way, how much have I paid for the Kilifi house so far?
I drive a Mazda CX-5, registration KDA 456Y, which I bought in February 2025 for KES 3,200,000. I sold my old Toyota Fielder, KCB 123X, to my cousin Njoroge in March 2025.
The Mazda is insured with Bima Bora Insurance; the policy expires on 31 July 2026. My driving licence is due for renewal on 1 August 2026, and my passport expires on 10 March 2027.

seeds.text: 9 April 2025. Back from Dubai with Samuel; we flew out on 3 April. Best holiday in years. We agreed to take the kids next time.

seeds: I'm studying for CIFA with KASNEB; the final exam is on 24 November 2026. Wanjiku's school fees of KES 85,000 are due on 5 July 2026, and I have a dentist appointment on 20 June 2026.
Samuel and I have decided Baraka will go to boarding school in 2027. I plan to move the family into the Kilifi house in January 2027, and one day I want to retire at 55 and farm in Nyeri.
Mama yangu atatimiza miaka 75 Septemba hii. Nimepanga kumpeleka Mombasa kwa sikukuu ya Krismasi.
I studied for my BCom at the University of Nairobi and graduated in 2007.
For the Kilifi house we decided on solar power instead of the grid. Halima wants Njeri Bakes to start a catering arm next year, and I plan to clear the Sacco loan by December 2027.
